lbl_16_data_0.evidence: profile:_prolog advances biography records by 0x3000; fn_16_1038 multiplies pilot indices by 0x3000 and slot indices by 0x800. Retail contains 41 such records, then 41 pairs of six 0x40-byte machine-text slots at 0x7B000. Every slot is NUL-terminated and otherwise zero padded. Slot 0 contains English text, slot 5 Shift-JIS, slots 1-4 are empty. Machine-text pairs contain engine and maker strings.

lbl_16_bss_B0B8.evidence: profile:fn_16_1038 at 0x1154-0x1168 indexes lbl_16_bss_B0B8 by pilot * 0x3000 + language * 0x800 before copying the formatted biography. The 0x7B000-byte symbol holds exactly 41 records.

lbl_1_data_1AEA8.evidence: font.h and bitmap.h recover the first 0x38 bytes of lbl_1_data_1AEA8 (u32 at 0, bytes at 4/5 and 0x10/0x11, words at 8/0xC, floats at 0x14/0x18/0x34). Retail repeats that record 44 times (0x9A0 = 44 * 0x38): every record has relocations at 0x24 (a string), 0x2C and 0x30, 1.0f at 0x34, and float-valued words at 0x1C/0x20; bytes 6-7 and 0x12-0x13 are zero.

lbl_1_data_FCD4.evidence: main_rel:fn_1_47E54 rejects indices above 0xBB and reads lbl_1_data_FCD4 + index * 0x28 + 4 + lbl_801A66B4 * 4 (the language slot); fn_1_47EE4 and the bitmap.c loaders step 0x28-byte records. Retail holds exactly 188 records: offsets 4-0x18 always point at the six per-language paths (bmp_e/, bmp_g/, bmp_f/, bmp_s/, bmp_i/, bmp/ ...tpl.lz), 0x1C at the bank name (BMP_COM), and every other word is zero.

lbl_8_rodata_48.evidence: title:fn_8_EC4 walks this table two 8-byte records per step (lwzx/lwzu of the s32 image id, lbz of the flags byte); its matched block declares the same TitleEntry {s32 image; u8 flags; u8 pad; u16 y} as TitleEntry[4][2]. -2 marks an empty slot and -1 the end.

lbl_1_rodata_26F8.evidence: The default FontDrawPacket (include/font.h, 0x58 bytes) that sel, title, customize, interview and main_rel blocks copy whole before filling (`pkt = lbl_1_rodata_26F8`, lwzu/stwu copy loops); fn_1_D07E0 reads its z field (+0xC) with lfs. Fields follow font.h: z 0.1, scale/uv 1.0, alpha 1.0, flags 5, color 0xFFFFFFFF. Named apart from font.h's typedef so both can be in scope.

lbl_1_rodata_4AE0.evidence: Six 0x4C-byte save-kind records (memcard.c fn_1_B22AC indexes `&lbl_1_rodata_4AE0[kind]` as MemcardKind; driver.c reads unk_40/44/48 as DriverDesc). Each holds a NUL-padded save name at 0 ("f_zero_debug", "f_zero", "fzg", ...; memcard.c passes +0x98/+0x130/+0x17C as name prefixes), a file name at 0x20 ("sys_e.bin", "gho_e.bin", ...), a size word at 0x3C, the kind index at 0x40 and two -1 words.

lbl_1_data_3F244.evidence: cloth.c:fn_1_102FD0 passes lbl_1_data_3F244 as the rule table of burner.c:fn_1_9D0EC, whose matched C walks NameRule {s32 type; char *str;} records until str is NULL (type 0 prefix, 1 exact, 2 suffix match against a model part name). Retail holds 8 such records: seven with a string relocation at +4 (_NOISE, GATEWAKU01/02, GATEPANEL01/02, FLAG, REPAIRPOINT) and a terminator {3, NULL}.

lbl_1_data_3F28C.evidence: cloth.c:fn_1_1050D0 steps lbl_1_data_3F28C by 16 bytes for i < 6 and reads the four bytes at +0..+3 as indices into the eight vertices of lbl_1_data_3F2EC. Retail: six quads of a box, each followed by three floats that are its unit face normal (+-1.0 on one axis, 0 elsewhere).

lbl_1_data_3F2EC.evidence: cloth.c:fn_1_1050D0 reads lbl_1_data_3F2EC as Vec[] indexed by the face bytes of lbl_1_data_3F28C (0..7) and writes x, y, z to the GX FIFO. Retail: 8 x 12 bytes, the corners of a box (x +-22.3, y 7.8 or -7.0, z 14.6 or -6.7).
